The '''Tanallay Surge posting agency''' was a [[Posting Agency|posting agency]] for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] located at the [[Tanallay Surge complex]] on the<ref name="BoFettCode" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]]. A dingy and dark place, the agency featured an information desk and several [[Painting/Legends|posters]].<ref name="BoFettCode" />

At some point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="EPIVdate">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' includes an [[in-universe]] copy of the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]], which contains an illustration of the Tanallay Surge [[Posting Agency|posting agency]] and is annotated by [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]]. The Handbook therefore must have been published at some point prior to Greedo's [[Death/Legends|death]], which is depicted in {{Film|IV}}, the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the posting agency was visited by two [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]]; one checked the posters on the wall while another engaged in conversation with a being behind the desk. An [[R5-series astromech droid]] was also present at the agency at the same [[Time/Legends|time]]. The visit of the two bounty hunters was depicted in an illustration of the posting agency published in the Updated [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Edition of the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]].<ref name="BoFettCode" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tanallay Surge posting agency was first mentioned in the [[2013]] reference book ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Ryder Windham]], and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="BoFettCode" />
